title: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Gerald Kelsoe Contracting and Precision Paint Experts in Lake City or Fort White? What to ask about service area, scheduling, and crews.
h1: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Homeowners in Columbia County often wonder whether a painter will really make the drive. This guide covers the questions to ask about coverage and scheduling.

questions: Do Gainesville-area painters serve Lake City and Fort White?
What should I ask a painter about travel and scheduling?

sections.h2: Hiring a painter outside the big markets
body: Gerald Kelsoe Contracting is one of the painting and property-service companies homeowners in North Central Florida may be comparing. If you live in Lake City, Fort White, or out on acreage in Columbia County, an extra layer of questions applies. A contractor may list your town but schedule it only when a crew happens to be nearby, or quote it without seeing the property. Clarifying coverage up front saves weeks of waiting later.
This page does not describe any other company's service area. It explains what to ask every bidder and spells out how Precision Paint Experts covers Columbia County.

Distance should not change the quality of the paperwork. A homeowner on a county road deserves the same itemized scope, named products, and written schedule as someone a few blocks from the shop. If a bid for your property is thinner than you would expect in town, ask the contractor to fill in the gaps.

Precision Paint Experts is based in Newberry and serves five counties: Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist. In Columbia County, that means Lake City and Fort White. These are not afterthoughts on a list; the same walkthrough, written estimate, and process apply as for a job in Gainesville or Ocala.

bullets: Will someone walk my property in person before quoting?
How soon can a walkthrough be scheduled out here?
What is the expected start window after approval?
Will the crew be your own employees each day of the job?
Is the warranty the same for my location as for jobs closer to your base?

sections.h2: What a Columbia County project looks like with us
body: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and a crew lead, not a salesperson, measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings where needed. The written, itemized quote usually arrives within one business day, and most projects start one to three weeks after approval. We use our own crews, never subcontractors, so the people working on a Fort White farmhouse are the same people who work in town.

Stucco homes can develop cracking that should be addressed before painting, which our post on Lake City stucco cracks explains. Our written workmanship warranty, up to 10 years on exterior work, applies in Columbia County just as it does closer to Newberry, layered over the manufacturer's coverage.

Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Request a free, no-obligation estimate and compare it with others using the questions above. The estimate will list surfaces included and excluded, prep steps, primer and topcoat products, coat counts, and the schedule, and nothing is added later without your written approval. If you are in neighboring Gilchrist County, the same applies in Trenton, and if you are closer to High Springs or Alachua, those towns are covered too. Our Lake City painting services page has more on the work we do in the area.

faqs.q: Do you really serve Fort White?
faqs.a: Yes. Fort White and Lake City in Columbia County are both part of our five-county service area.

faqs.q: Will you quote my rural property without visiting?
faqs.a: No. A crew lead walks the property, measures, and photographs conditions before the written estimate is prepared.

faqs.q: Are your Lake City jobs subcontracted?
faqs.a: No. Precision Paint Experts uses its own crews on every project.
